rules: Every active repair transaction has exactly one canonical owner path resolved through SYSTEM-TOPOLOGY-002.json.
No repair transaction may create or transfer A-01 PASS, promotion, publication or production authority.
SUBJECT_FAILURE may create product repair work; admission/window/dependency/human/author/private/native/external/control-plane outcomes route to their truthful non-product-repair boundary.
An owner chat or Second Shift worker checks its repair inbox after current-authority reconciliation and before selecting unrelated build-ahead.
Changed candidate bytes require a new exact SHA and deterministic prequalification PASS on that same SHA before A01_REQUEUE_READY.
Completed/superseded/dead-letter transactions move to history; history is never erased to make an inbox look clean.
